control: control, reported separately as a robustness comparison
availability: 2 models x 2 climates x 2 densities x 3 extraction shares x 2 hour allowances: 48 possible combinations, 32 present. The sixteen 300-hour x10/x14 combinations are unavailable.
pairs: Enumerate every unordered pair within model/climate that differs in exactly one of density, extraction or hours_worker_year. Orient low to central density, smaller to larger extraction, and 300 to 600 hours. Never match across climate or model.
rank: For each model, climate and outcome separately, rank factors by largest absolute matched difference over the available declared endpoints; also report median absolute difference, pair count and the maximum pair. Ties share rank. No combined-unit score, empirical uncertainty interval or equal-range interpretation. Extraction pairs are overlapping scenario contrasts, not independent samples.
checks: Re-read archived result/diagnostic values, check all availability and all allowed/excluded pair combinations independently, recompute reductions, confirm result/review identities and parent qualification protections. Reproduce exports in a separate directory. No model rerun.
